title: Corporate Travel Programmes: Subscription and Contract Term Tariff
content:
Forty-nine dollars a month buys the smallest of the Corporate Travel Programmes; six thousand five hundred buys the largest. This schedule publishes that one facet of the tariff across every tier: the platform subscription, the one-off implementation charge, the length and renewal of the contract term, and the charge for ending a term before it expires. Every amount is stated in United States dollars and belongs only to the tier named in its row.

## What each column states

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Monthly subscription | Monthly platform subscription for the programme, in USD |
| Annual subscription | Annual platform subscription where the company pays yearly, in USD |
| Contract term | Length of one contract term in calendar months |
| Automatic renewal | Whether the contract renews automatically at the end of its term |
| Renewal notice | Calendar days before the term ends by which notice not to renew must be given |
| Early exit charge | Charge for ending the contract before the term expires, in USD |
| Onboarding charge | One-off implementation charge when the programme is activated, in USD |
| Implementation | Working days the implementation takes from activation |

## Tariff by tier

| Programme tier | Monthly subscription | Annual subscription | Contract term | Automatic renewal | Renewal notice | Early exit charge | Onboarding charge | Implementation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Business Starter Programme | 49.00 | 499.00 | 1 month | Yes | 0 days | 0.00 | 0.00 | 1 day |
| Business Team Programme | 149.00 | 1490.00 | 12 months | Yes | 30 days | 750.00 | 250.00 | 5 days |
| Business Pro Programme | 449.00 | 4490.00 | 12 months | Yes | 30 days | 2250.00 | 950.00 | 10 days |
| Business Enterprise Programme | 1250.00 | 12500.00 | 24 months | Yes | 60 days | 7500.00 | 3500.00 | 20 days |
| Business Enterprise Plus Programme | 2950.00 | 29500.00 | 24 months | Yes | 90 days | 18000.00 | 9500.00 | 30 days |
| Business Global Programme | 6500.00 | 65000.00 | 36 months | Yes | 120 days | 39000.00 | 25000.00 | 45 days |

## Notes to the schedule

1. Automatic renewal is published for all six tiers alike; the tiers differ in the notice period, which runs from nil on the Business Starter Programme to 120 calendar days on the Business Global Programme.
2. The Business Starter Programme is the only tier whose published early exit charge and published onboarding charge are both nil; each of the other five publishes a positive amount for both.
3. Two tiers share a contract term of 12 months and two share a term of 24 months, so the term alone does not identify a tier. Reading a tier from this schedule takes the row, not a single column.
